question: The Swarna Jayanti Shahari Rojgar Yojana (SJSRY) was launched in the year ________ by Government of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1997**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Swarna Jayanti Shahari Rojgar Yojana (SJSRY)** was launched in the year **1997**__ by the Government of India.
 
• SJSRY is aimed at providing gainful employment to the urban unemployed and underemployed poor by encouraging the setting up of self-employment ventures or provision of wage employment.
 
• The scheme focuses on providing skill development training to the urban poor to enhance their employability.
 
• It also includes support for the establishment of micro-enterprises by urban poor women and youth.
 
• The implementation of the scheme is done by urban local bodies (ULBs) with the support of state governments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The scheme was restructured and subsumed into the National Urban Livelihoods Mission (NULM) in 2013.
 
• SJSRY had five major components: Urban Self-Employment Programme (USEP), Urban Wage Employment Programme (UWEP), Skill Training for Employment Promotion amongst Urban Poor (STEP-UP), Urban Women Self-help Programme (UWSP), and Urban Community Development Network (UCDN).
 
• The focus of the scheme was to provide sustainable livelihood opportunities through skill development and micro-enterprises, with a special emphasis on women and vulnerable sections of society.
 
• Under the scheme, urban local bodies were encouraged to form community structures such as self-help groups (SHGs) and community development societies (CDSs) to facilitate the implementation of the program.
